units.source_text: 庭前不植乱草杂木，只种着许多抚子花，有中国种的，也有日本种的，色彩配合得很调和。

en.t: No wild grasses or miscellaneous trees were planted before the garden; only many pinks grew there, some of Chinese varieties and some of Japanese, their colors arranged in pleasing harmony.

units.source_text: 许多花傍着雅致的篱垣到处乱开，这夕暮的景色实在美丽。

en.t: Many flowers bloomed freely here and there along the elegant fences, and the evening scene was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 跟源氏来此的诸公子走近花旁，但因不能随意折取，心中很不满足，彷徨不忍遽去。

en.t: The young noblemen who had come with Genji drew near the flowers, but since they could not pick them as they pleased, they felt unsatisfied and lingered there, reluctant to leave at once.

units.source_text: 源氏对玉鬘说：“这些都是聪明俊秀的年轻人呢。

en.t: Genji said to Tamakazura, "These are all intelligent and handsome young men.

units.source_text: 他们各有各的优点。

en.t: Each of them has his own merits.

units.source_text: 尤其是柏木右中将，态度更是稳重，品质特别高雅。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Right Middle Captain, is especially composed in manner and particularly refined in character.

units.source_text: 他后来怎样？

en.t: How has he been since then?

units.source_text: 有信来么？

en.t: Has any letter come from him?

units.source_text: 你不可置之不理，使他伤心。”

en.t: You must not ignore him and make him grieve."

units.source_text: 夕雾中将在群贤之中，也特别优越。

en.t: Among that company of worthy men, Yugiri, the Middle Captain, was also especially outstanding.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“内大臣厌恶夕雾，实乃意外之事。

en.t: Genji said, "It is truly unexpected that the Minister of the Interior should dislike Yugiri.

units.source_text: 他是否希望皇族保持纯粹的血统而繁荣，不要源氏家族的血交混进去，因而拒绝他呢？”

en.t: Does he reject him because he wishes the imperial family to flourish while keeping its bloodline pure, without the blood of the Genji family mingling with it?"

units.source_text: 玉鬘说：“那妹妹本人总是盼望‘亲王早光临’的吧。”

en.t: Tamakazura said, "Surely the younger sister herself is always hoping that the prince will soon come to her."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“不然，他们并不希望‘请来作东床。

en.t: Genji said, "No, they do not hope to invite him in as a son-in-law.

units.source_text: 肴馔何所有’那么殷勤招待，只是破坏两个幼童的美满之梦，使他们永远隔绝，内大臣这用心太残忍了。

en.t: They are not offering him such warm hospitality with food and drink; instead, they are destroying the happy dream of two young people and separating them forever. The Minister of the Interior is too cruel in this intention.

units.source_text: 如果嫌夕雾官位低，有伤他家体面，那么只要装作不知道二人之事，而将女儿亲事信托我，我总不会使他有后患的。”

en.t: If he thinks Yugiri's rank is too low and would damage his family's dignity, then he need only pretend not to know about the two of them and entrust his daughter's marriage to me; I would certainly never leave him with future trouble."

units.source_text: 说罢叹息一声。

en.t: After saying this, he sighed once.

units.source_text: 玉鬘听了这话，才知道源氏与内大臣之间有此隔阂。

en.t: Hearing this, Tamakazura only then understood that such estrangement existed between Genji and the Minister of the Interior.

units.source_text: 如此看来，她何时始得与父亲相见，渺不可知。

en.t: Seen in this light, it was impossible to know when she would ever be able to meet her father.

units.source_text: 为此不胜悲伤忧恨。

en.t: Because of this, she was overcome with sorrow, worry, and resentment.
